Subject: Proposed addendum: private cluster nodes and regional price carveout

Sergio —

Thanks for the demo last week. Per our internal review, we need an addendum to the Order Form and a small update to the MSA to cover a private cluster deployment scope and the associated node-based billing model. Key asks attached as a redline (AcmeOps_OrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf). High level:

- Add Exhibit X: Private Cluster SOW (short integration window, on-prem connector scope).
- Billing: Node-based monthly fee + per-token egress as a separate line item; include a regional surcharge for APAC-hosted nodes.
- Data handling: bench SOC2 evidence + KMS integration note in Section 5.

We're trying to keep legal overhead light — can you confirm whether Redwood can accept node-based fees (monthly) in the Order Form rather than changing the MSA pricing table? If not, we may need a narrow MSA amendment.

Attached is our annotated Order Form and a short comment log. Can we get a consolidated Redwood redline by next Wednesday so procurement can route for approval?

Appreciate it —
Marta Ruiz
Contracts Manager, AcmeOps
contracts@acmeops.com

Subject: Re: Proposed addendum: private cluster nodes and regional price carveout

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the redline and the clear asks. We attached a first-pass Redwood redline (RI_Addendum_PrivateCluster_nodes_20260627.docx) that keeps the MSA intact and implements Exhibit X in the Order Form as an addendum. Summary of our position:

- Node billing: we can support a monthly node fee (fixed per-region SKU) on the Order Form. It avoids changing the MSA pricing table.
- APAC surcharge: we'll include a region flag and a fixed surcharge percentage in Exhibit X; pricing will be listed on the Order Form as a separate line item per SKU.
- Data & KMS: legal wants the KMS integration clause to reference customer-managed keys where available; SOC2 artifacts can be shared via a secure drive link after an NDA addendum (we noted that in section 5).

Action items for Redwood:
1) Karthik: confirm legal language for limited MSA amendment vs. Order Form exhibit.
2) Laura: ops to confirm node sizing and expected throughput for the private cluster (we've put placeholders in Exhibit X).
3) Sergio: consolidate and return a final redline + DocuSign path for signature.

Can AcmeOps confirm signatory names and whether procurement prefers a single DocuSign envelope for both the Order Form addendum and the small MSA amendment (if required)? If procurement wants separate routing, note which will go to legal vs. execs.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez

Subject: RE: Proposed addendum: private cluster nodes and regional price carveout

Sergio / Laura —

Quick legal note after reviewing Marta's redline and Sergio's draft:

- Prefer to keep changes in the Order Form / Exhibit to avoid opening the full MSA for renegotiation. We'll add a single MSA footnote referencing the Exhibit (MSA §2.1 footnote) that permits per-customer exhibits to carry billing constructs. That keeps the MSA intact but gives procurement comfort.
- For node-based billing language: use a definition block called "Private Cluster Node (PCN) SKU" with a monthly charge and a separate "Egress per 1M tokens" line. Do not include token-based compute pricing in the same SKU — keeps invoicing clean.
- APAC surcharge: capped at 10% and represented as an explicit line item; don't call it a "surcharge" in the invoice, call it a "regional hosting premium" (less friction in procurement).
- SOW timeline: 6-8 week window for connector work with an ops acceptance criteria checklist. Put acceptance gating in Exhibit X, not the MSA.

I'll craft exact clauses for the footnote and the exhibit. Laura, please confirm the throughput assumptions so pricing lines are realistic.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
